body:
The following example crashes eslint (caused by the last line in the file):

```
var left, aSize, bSize;

aSize = {
  width: 800,
  height: 600
};

bSize = {
  width: 200,
  height: 100
};

left = (aSize.width/2) - ()
```

with error
